Source: Human coronaviruses cause both upper and lower respiratory tract infections in humans.
Luganda: Kkolona aleeta endwadde z’omu mussizo ogwa waggulu n’omuyitiro ogwa wansi mu bantu.
Yoruba: Àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn kòrónà ti fa ààrùn sí ẹ̀yà ara èémí tó lọ sókè àti èyí tó wá sílẹ̀ lára ènìyàn.

Hausa: Coronaviruses na ɗan’adam yana haifar da cututtukan hanyar numfashi na sama da na ƙasa a cikin mutane.
Northern Sotho: Coronavirus ya batho ka go bobedi diphetetšo tša tsela ya go hema ya ka godingwana le ya ka fasana go batho.

Source: In 2012, a sixth human coronavirus (hCoV) was isolated from a patient presenting with severe respiratory illness.
Luganda: Mu 2012, kkolona akwata abantu (hCoV) ow’omukaaga yazuulibwa mu mulwadde alina obuzibu obw’amaanyi mu kussa.
Yoruba: Ní ọdún 2012, wọ́n ya àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn kòrónà kẹfà (hCoV) sọ́tọ̀ láti ọ̀dọ aláìsàn tí ó ń ṣàárẹ ìmísókè mísódò.
Zulu: Ngo-2012, igciwane lokhuvethe lwabantu lwesithupha (hCoV) lahlukaniswa nesiguli esinesifo esinzima sokuphefumula.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2012, coronavirus na ɗan’adam na shida (hCoV) an keɓe shi daga majinyacin da ke fama da rashin lafiyar hanyar numfashi mai tsanani.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2012, coronavirus ya batho ya boselela (hCoV) e ile ya hlathwa go molwetši yo a bego a na le bolwetši bjo bo kekilego bja go hema.
Amharic: በ2012 ስድስተኛው የሰው ኮሮና ቫይረስ (hኮቫ) ከባድ የመተንፈሻ አካላት ህመም ካለበት ታካሚ ተለይቷል።

Source: The 60-year-old man died as a result of renal and respiratory failure after admission to a hospital in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
Luganda: Omusajja ow’emyaka 60 yafa olw’ensigo ze okulwala awamu n’okuba nga takyalina mukka gw’assa gumumala oluvannyuma lw’okutwalibwa mu ddwaliro mu kitundu kya Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
Yoruba: Arákùnrin tó tó bí i ọmọdún 60 ṣaláìsí látàrí ìkùnà kídìnì àti ìmísókè mísódò lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n gbàá ní ilé-ìwòsàn Jeddah, ní Saudi Arabia.
Zulu: Le ndoda ena-60 ishone ngenxa yokwehluleka kwezinso nokuphefumula ngemuva kokungeniswa esibhedlela e-Jeddah, e-Saudi Arabia.
Hausa: Mutumin mai shekaru 60 da haihuwa ya rasu ne sakamakon gazawar ƙoda da numfashi bayan an kwantar da shi a wani asibiti a Jeddah na ƙasar Saudiyya.
Northern Sotho: Monna wa mengwaga ye 60 o ile a hlokofala ka lebaka la go palelwa ke go šoma ga dipshio le go hema ka morago ga ge a amogetšwe ka sepetlele ka Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
Amharic: የ60 ዓመቱ አዛውንት በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ጂዳህ በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል ከገቡ በኋላ በኩላሊት እና በመተንፈሻ አካላት ችግር ምክንያት ህይወታቸው አልፏል።

Source: The aetiological agent was eventually identified as a coronavirus and designated Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).
Luganda: Akawuka kano oluvannyuma kaazuulwa okuba nga kaali kawuka ka kkolona akayitibwa Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).
Yoruba: Wọ́n padà ṣe àfihàn ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí tí ó má ń jẹ́ kí ààrùn wọnú ara gẹ́gẹ́ bí i àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn kòrónà àti yíyan ààrùn ìmísókè mísódò tí àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn corona ń fà ní àárín ilà-oòrùn (MERS-CoV).
Zulu: I-ejenti ye-aetiological ekugcineni yahlonzwa njenge-coronavirus futhi yaqokwa ukuthi i-Middle East ukhuvethe oluyisifo sokuphefumula (MERS-CoV).
Hausa: A ƙarshe an gano abin da yake haddasa cutar shi ne coronavirus kuma an an kira shi da cutar conorona na numfashi ta Gabas ta Tsakiya (MERS-CoV).
Northern Sotho: Seo se bakilego phetetšo ye mafelelong se ile sa utollwa gore ke coronavirus le bolwetši bja coronavirus bja go palediša go hema bja Middle East (MERS-CoV).
Amharic: በሂደት የበሽታ መነሾ ወኪሉ ኮሮና ቫይረስ እና የመካከላኛው ምስራቅ የመተንፈሻ አካላት ሲንድሮም ኮሮና ቫይረስ (MERS-ኮቫ) ተብሎ የተሰየመው እንደሆነ ተለይቷል።

Source: MERS-CoV has now been reported in more than 27 countries across the Middle East, Europe, North Africa and Asia.
Luganda: Akawuka ka MERS-CoV kazuuliddwa mu mawanga agasukka mu 27 okwetooloola ebitundu bya Midlle East, Bulaaya, Obukiikakkono bw’Afirika ne Asia.
Yoruba: A ti gbọ́ ìròyìn MERS-CoV ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó tó 27 ní apá àárín ìlà-oòrùn, Europe, apá àríwá ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà àti Asia.
Zulu: I-MERS-CoV manje isibikwe emazweni angaphezu kuka-27 e-Middle East, eYurophu, eNyakatho Afrika nase-Asia.
Hausa: Yanzu an sami rahoton MERS-CoV a cikin ƙasashe sama da 27 a Gabas ta Tsakiya, Turai, Arewacin Afirka da kuma Asiya.
Northern Sotho: MERS-CoV e ile ya begwa gore e gona ka dinageng tša go feta tše 27 go ralala le Middle East, Yuropa, Leboa la Afrika le Asia.
Amharic: MERS-ኮቫ አሁን ላይ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ፣ በአውሮፓ፣ በሰሜን አፍሪካ እና በእስያ ከ27 በላይ ሃገራት ውስጥ ሪፖርት ተደርጓል።

Source: As of July 2017, 2040 MERS-CoV laboratory confirmed cases, resulting in 712 deaths, were reported globally, with a majority of these cases from the Arabian Peninsula.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku mbeera nga bwe yali mu Gwomusanvu 2017, kyakakasibwa nti abantu 2040 be baali bazuuliddwamu MERS-CoV mu bifo omukebererwa endwadde era ne kiviirako abantu 712 okufa, ng’abantu abasinga abaazuulwamu akawuka kano baali bava mu mawanga g’Abawarabu.
Yoruba: Ní ǹkan bí i oṣù kéje ọdún 2017, yàrá ìmọ ìjìnlẹ 2040 MERS-CoV jẹ́rìí sí àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kan, tí ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn tó kú tó bí i 712 tí wọ́n sì ròyìn fún gbogbo àgbáyé, tí ọ̀pọ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà wáyé ní apá pẹnísúlà àwọn Arabia.
Zulu: Kusukela kuNtulikazi/Julayi 2017, ilabhorethri ye-MERS-CoV yaqinisekisa amacala angu-2040, okuholele ekufeni kwabantu abangu-712, abikwa emhlabeni jikelele, iningi lalezi zimo livela eNhlonhlweni yase-Arabia.
Hausa: Ya zuwa watan Yulin na shekarar 2017, ɗakin gwaje-gwaje na MERS-CoV na 2040 ya tabbatar da kamuwa da cutar, wanda ya yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 712, a duk duniya, tare da mafi yawan waɗannan kamuwa daga yankin Larabawa.
Northern Sotho: Ka Julae 2017, diphetetšo tše di tiišeditšwego ka laporathoring tše 2040 tša MERS-CoV, tšeo di feleleditšego ka mahu a 712, di ile tša begwa lefaseng ka bophara, fao e lego gore bontši bja diphetetšo tše di bego di etšwa Arabian Peninsula.
Amharic: ከጁላይ 2017 ጀምሮ 2040 በላብራቶሪ የተረጋገጡ የMERS-ኮቫ ኬዞች የተገኙ ሲሆን 712 ሰዎች መሞታቸው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ሪፖርት ተደርጓል፤ ከእነዚህም ውስጥ አብዛኛዎቹ ከአረብ የባህር ሰርጥ የተገኙ ነበሩ።

Source: This review summarises the current understanding of MERS-CoV, with special reference to the (i) genome structure; (ii) clinical features; (iii) diagnosis of infection; and (iv) treatment and vaccine development.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza kuno kufunza entegeera eriwo ku kawuka ka MERS-CoV, okusinziira ku (i) kikula ky’endagabutonde; (ii) obubonero; (iii) okukebera obulwadde; ne (iv) obujjanjabi n’okukola eddagala.
Yoruba: Àtúnyẹ̀wò yìí ṣe àkópọ̀ níní òye lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ nípa MERS-CoV, pẹ̀lú ìtọ́kasí tó pàtàkì sí (i) ìgbékalẹ̀ apó ẹ̀yọ́-ìran; (ii) àwọn abùdá ìwòsàn; (iii) ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò ààrùn; àti (iv) ìtọ́jú àti ìdàgbàsókè àjẹsára.
Zulu: Leli phepha lifingqa ukuqonda kwamanje kwe-MERS-CoV, ngokubhekisela ngokukhethekile (i) kusakhiwo sofuzo jikelele;(ii) izimo zezokuhlengwa; (iii) ukutholwa kokutheleleka; kanye (iv) nokuthuthukiswa kokwelashwa nomgomo.
Hausa: Wannan bita ta taƙaita fahimtar hali na yanzu na MERS-CoV, tare da tunani na musamman ga tsarin (i) tsarin ƙwayoyin halitta; (ii) siffofi na asibiti; (iii) ganewar asali na kamuwa da cuta; da (iv) jiyya da haɓaka rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Tekodišišo ye e fa kakaretšo ya kwešišo ya bjale ya MERS-CoV, go lebeletšwe kudu (i) sebopego sa tshedeimošo ya ditšini; (ii) ditlabelo tša kalafi; (iii) phekolo ya phetetšo; le (iv) kalafo le go hlama moento.
Amharic: ይህ ግምገማ (i) የጂኖም መዋቅርን፣ (ii) ክሊኒካዊ ባህሪያትን፣ (iii) የኢንፌክሽን ምርመራን እና (iv) የህክምና እና የክትባት መዳበርን ልዩ ማጣቀሻ በማድረግ የMERS-ኮቫን ወቅታዊ ግንዛቤ ያጠቃልላል።

Source: In 2018, researchers reviewed what we know about Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus (MERS-CoV), or MERS, in the 6 years since it was first discovered in 2012.
Luganda: Mu 2018, abanoonyereza beekaliriza bye tumanyi ku kawuka akamanyiddwa nga Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus (MERS-CoV), oba MERS, mu myaka 6 okuva lwe kaasooka okuzuulwa mu 2012.
Yoruba: Ní ọdún 2018, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àtúnyẹ̀wò ohun tí a mọ̀ nípa ààrùn ìmísókè mísódò tí àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn kòrónà ń fà ní àárín ilà-oòrùn àgbáyé (MERS-CoV), tàbi MERS, ní ọdún 6 ṣẹ́yìn ni wọ́n ti kọ́kọ́ ṣàwárí rẹ̀ ní ọdún 2012.
Zulu: Ngo-2018, abacwaningi babheke esikwaziyo nge-Middle East Ukhuvethe oluyisifo sokuphefumula (MERS-CoV), noma i-MERS, eminyakeni engu-6 kusukela yaqala ukutholakala ngo-2012.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2018, masu bincike sun sake nazarin abin da muka sani game da Cutar Corona na Numfashi ta Gabas ta Tsakiya (MERS-CoV), ko MERS, a cikin shekaru 6 tun lokacin da aka fara gano ta a cikin shekarar 2012.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2018, banyakišiši ba ile ba lekodišiša seo re se tsebago ka ga Coronavirus ya Mohemo ya Middle East (MERS-CoV), goba MERS, mo mengwageng ye 6 go tloga mola e utollwago la mathomo ka 2012.
Amharic: በ2018 ተመራማሪዎች ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በ2012 ከተገኘ በኋላ ባሉት 6 ዓመታት ስለ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ የመተንፈሻ አካላት ሲንድሮም ኮሮና ቫይረስ (MERS-ኮቫ) ወይም MERS ያወቅነውን ሁሉ ገምግመዋል።

Source: The review was publishedat a time when MERS was still the most infectious human coronavirus yet discovered.
